name: compass_turn
description: Rotate a cardinal facing direction by left/right/around turns; matched control copies the starting direction.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
dirs=['north','east','south','west']; turns={'left':-1,'right':1,'around':2}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 d=random.randrange(4); seq=[random.choice(list(turns)) for _ in range(random.randint(1,3))]
 context='You are facing '+dirs[d]+'. You turn '+', then '.join(seq)+'.'
 items.append({'prompt':context+' What direction are you facing now? Answer:', 'answer':' '+dirs[(d+sum(turns[x] for x in seq))%4]})
 control.append({'prompt':context+' What direction were you facing initially? Answer:', 'answer':' '+dirs[d]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
